ASS00039 is a laboratory test code used in the Danish healthcare system to measure [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src2]. It is one of several specific codes utilized to identify and register performed TSH measurements for clinical quality indicators [^src1]. Specifically, it is recognized as a valid code for fulfilling the criteria of indicator 3, which tracks TSH measurement in the national quality assurance efforts for patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1].

The code appears in technical guidelines published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) as part of the "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (AFDK) reports [^src1] [^src2]. In the 2024 edition of the AFDK report, ASS00039 is listed among a defined set of laboratory codes (alongside others like NPU27547 and DNK35895) that count toward the numerator for the TSH measurement quality indicator [^src1]. The 2025 edition expands this list of accepted codes for TSH and other laboratory measurements, continuing to include ASS00039 as a standard identifier for this thyroid-stimulating hormone test in national registry analyses [^src2]. These coding standards serve as a technical reference for implementing and calculating healthcare quality metrics across Danish health registries [^src1] [^src2].
